import pyautogui, time, subprocess, re
# Reflection: VLC is already configured above the old 125% limit and is sitting at 194%; set VLC's volume to exactly 200%, with a mouse-wheel fallback on the visible volume control.
pyautogui.click(945, 550)
time.sleep(0.1)
ok = False
try:
    names_out = subprocess.check_output(
        ['gdbus', 'call', '--session', '--dest', 'org.freedesktop.DBus', '--object-path', '/org/freedesktop/DBus', '--method', 'org.freedesktop.DBus.ListNames'],
        text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL
    )
    names = re.findall(r"org\.mpris\.MediaPlayer2\.vlc[^']*", names_out) or ['org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.vlc']
    for name in names:
        r = subprocess.run(
            ['gdbus', 'call', '--session', '--dest', name, '--object-path', '/org/mpris/MediaPlayer2', '--method', 'org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Set', 'org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.Player', 'Volume', '<double 2.0>'],
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL
        )
        if r.returncode == 0:
            ok = True
            break
except Exception:
    ok = False
if not ok:
    pyautogui.moveTo(1190, 775)
